boundary_atlas.complex_conjugation: complex conjugation paired with time reversal preserves the geometric intensity orbit
boundary_atlas.coupling_zero: identity flow; every nonzero real coupling is reduced by time rescaling and sign reversal
boundary_atlas.formal_quantization: bosonic cubic interaction is only a formal hint; no operator-domain or spectral theorem is asserted
boundary_atlas.h_zero_unequal: smooth chart crossings; intensity period is half the full complex-state period
boundary_atlas.maximal_abs_h: double accessible root and two-frequency relative equilibrium
boundary_atlas.n1_or_n2_zero: if either Manley-Rowe invariant vanishes the state lies on an equilibrium axis
boundary_atlas.origin_and_axes: the origin and each complex coordinate axis are equilibrium families

collision_boundary.C211: Hamiltonian Lotka-Volterra period annulus, not a complex resonant wave triad with two phase returns
collision_boundary.C230: open Toda Lax scattering, not a cubic three-mode wave interaction
collision_boundary.C235: cyclic population dynamics with mutation, not a canonical complex Hamiltonian triad
collision_boundary.C256: KdV traveling-wave cnoidal profiles, not full finite-dimensional complex-amplitude dynamics

model.domain: all z in complex three-space with source interaction time

nonclaims: No priority claim is made for three-wave equations, Manley-Rowe relations, or elliptic integration.
Intensity recurrence alone is not claimed to imply recurrence of the full complex state.
The formal bosonic analogy is not a proved self-adjoint quantization or a complete quantum spectrum.
No target arithmetic datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, target divisor, functional equation, target-zero match, Hilbert-Polya operator, or Route-B input is claimed.

parameter_grid.evidence_role: exact and high-precision finite receipt, not proof by sampling

references.role: primary coupled optical three-wave amplitude source
